# Reviewed daml-lint findings, one per line: "<severity> <detector> <file>: <message>".
# `make lint` fails when a finding is missing from this list or an entry here no
# longer occurs. Add an entry only after reviewing the finding; record why it is
# not a defect in the comment above its group.

# An empty list fails the downstream checks that the holdings cover the amount
# (TradeOffer.settleTransfer and RedeemRequest.ConsumeRedeem).
HIGH missing-positive-amount vault-example/public/daml/Vault.daml: Choice 'Buy' accepts list parameter 'treasuryHoldingCids' but has no minimum-length check.
HIGH missing-positive-amount vault-example/public/daml/Vault.daml: Choice 'HandleRedeem' accepts list parameter 'treasuryHoldingCids' but has no minimum-length check.
HIGH missing-positive-amount vault-example/public/daml/Vault.daml: Choice 'Sell' accepts list parameter 'treasuryHoldingCids' but has no minimum-length check.
